spans.says: Casper is building Vprogs, verifiable programs, real apps on a base layer, on a proof of work, not an L2.

Casper does four jobs. It orders every transaction so Casper itself is the sequencer. It stores the data, it checks the proofs, it meters the work. What it never does is run the app. The app runs on its own nodes.
Sovereignty. If another app breaks, yours keeps running.
Proof of work money with apps on it and no L2 in the middle.
